reviews.t: Didn't like this, stick to falsies but Customer Service is amazing
reviews.x: The magnets are pre-stuck on the band, so you can't really trim it without removing one of the magnets on the end. Also, the application was really hard––there's no magnetic liner like a lot of other products, so the way that the lashes "stick" to your face is by sandwiching between your real lashes. I couldn't get it to stick well.  However, the customer service is really nice. They reached out to me regarding what I didn't like about the product and seemed really passionate in this item.

reviews.t: They’re a good quick alternative to glue on
reviews.x: These lashes are a good alternative to glue ons. They do need to be cut and curved a bit before putting them on. Once you get the hang of it they are easy to put on. It also is great because you can take them off and readjust without messing your makeup up!
I recieved the order within 2 days, it was well packaged. The lashes were easy to apply following the package instructions. Nice product for the price.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply once they get the hang of it, though several note a learning curve for beginners.
Some reviewers report the lashes stick to the applicator instead of staying on the eyes, or that the magnets don't align properly.
Reviewers praise the soft, natural look and the ability to customize or readjust without glue.
Several reviewers criticize the instructions as vague or unclear.
A few reviewers report quality issues such as lashes ripping or difficulty trimming due to pre-stuck magnets.
